title: Interlaced Wattle Hurdle
description: One newly authored static low-poly wattle fence hurdle: nine independent continuous rounded branches weave alternately in front of and behind three complete upright stakes. Neighbouring branch rows use opposite weave phase, with real three-dimensional routing rather than flat crossed strips or texture. Three opaque constant wood PBR materials. Separate closed editable components, no reused prior fence or basket mesh. Horizontal whole-bounds centre and flat stake soles at Z0. Visual interlacing only: not simulated weaving, motion, growth, fencing effectiveness, structural load, stability, safety or fabrication guidance.
